caption: The drawing depicts two rectangular panels side by side, each with an arched top, filled with floral motifs and framed by vertical and horizontal borders decorated in green, red, and yellow tones. The left panel features a large central red flower with multiple petals, flanked by four smaller red flowers and green leafy stems. Above the central flower, there are two small red flowers, the letters "LB" on the left and "HI" on the right, and a triangular gray shield with a black bird in the center. A blue floral border decorates the top of the arch. The right panel contains a symmetrical arrangement of red flowers in a yellow vase with green stems, topped by a circular star design in red and blue, and a wreath of green leaves following the arch. Both panels have side columns with a repeated floral pattern in red, green, and yellow, and the background throughout is a pale yellow color.
title: Pa. German Love Chest
